a.lede: The heads of the biggest AI labs — Google, Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, and Nvidia — went to Washington and signed the 'Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities,' promising to develop their own models safely. Trump says that it's the best way to move forward with AI as it balances progress with safety.
a.title: Top AI tech executives promise to ‘self-police’ AI development

b.lede: Asking AI companies to self-regulate is a great way to pretend like you’ve accomplished something.
b.title: Whatever AI Safety Is, It’s Not This
